articles.title: Fujimori government revives war on the left with detentions of artists and activists
articles.author: Pablo Meriguet
articles.content_excerpt: Organizations in Peru raised the alarm about the arbitrary arrest of several progressive artists and activists on November 19. The arrests were reportedly carried out by the Counterterrorism Directorate (DIRCOTE) in the cities of Cusco, Lima, and Tarapoto. Hip-hop artists Brenda Jah (Brenda Mejía) and Pedro Mo (Pedro Mosquera) were arrested in Lima and Cusco respectively and will reportedly be held for 15 days in preliminary detention, as requested by the Prosecutor’s Office specializing in terrorism offenses. In addition to the artists, leftist organizers Libia Arcila, David Tapullima, and Polidoro Tapullima were arrested and face a similar 15 days in preliminary detention.
